type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.Outcome.associativity
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α β γ : Type u} (oa : Universe00.Core.Outcome α) (f : α → Universe00.Core.Outcome β)   (g : β → Universe00.Core.Outcome γ), oa >>= f >>= g = oa >>= fun x => f x >>= g

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.Outcome.first_limit_dominates
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α β : Type u} (ℓ : Universe00.Core.LimitState),   α → ∀ (f : α → Universe00.Core.Outcome β), Universe00.Core.Outcome.limit ℓ >>= f = Universe00.Core.Outcome.limit ℓ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.Outcome.left_identity
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α β : Type u} (a : α) (f : α → Universe00.Core.Outcome β), Universe00.Core.Outcome.pure a >>= f = f a

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.Outcome.limit_preserves_through_bind
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α β : Type u} (ℓ : Universe00.Core.LimitState) (f : α → Universe00.Core.Outcome β),   Universe00.Core.Outcome.limit ℓ >>= f = Universe00.Core.Outcome.limit ℓ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.Outcome.limit_preserves_through_map
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α β : Type u} (f : α → β) (ℓ : Universe00.Core.LimitState),   Universe00.Core.Outcome.map f (Universe00.Core.Outcome.limit ℓ) = Universe00.Core.Outcome.limit ℓ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.Outcome.right_identity
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u} (oa : Universe00.Core.Outcome α), oa >>= Universe00.Core.Outcome.pure = oa

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.Regime.conservativeExtension_refl
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (r : Regime) : conservativeExtension r r = true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.Regime.conservativeExtension_trans
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (r1 r2 r3 : Regime) : conservativeExtension r1 r2 = true → conservativeExtension r2 r3 = true → conservativeExtension r1 r3 = true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Examples.claimIsVerified

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Examples.classicalIsLimit
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∃ ℓ : LimitState, classicalExample = Outcome.limit ℓ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.classical_embedding_preserves
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (x : α) : (classical_embedding x).isValue = true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.classical_logic_preserved
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : False → ∀ (P : Prop), P

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.classical_regime_faithful
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} : Universe00.Core.Regime.Classical = Universe00.Core.Regime.Classical

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.composition_preserves_first_limit
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β γ : Type u} (f : α → Outcome β) (g : β → Outcome γ) (ℓ : LimitState) : ((Outcome.limit ℓ : Outcome α) >>= f) >>= g = (Outcome.limit ℓ : Outcome γ)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.incompatible_regimes_detected
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β γ : Type u} (op1 : RegimeIndexedOp α β) (op2 : RegimeIndexedOp β γ) : ¬regimesCompatible op1.regime op2.regime → ∃ ℓ : LimitState, True

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.limit_excludes_value
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (ℓ : LimitState) : ¬ ∃ (a : α), (Outcome.limit ℓ : Outcome α) = Outcome.value a

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.limit_no_explosion
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (ℓ : LimitState) (P Q : Prop) : (∃ (x : Outcome α), x = Outcome.limit ℓ) → ¬(P ∧ Q) ∨ (P ∧ Q)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.limit_not_false
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (ℓ : LimitState) (arb : α) : ¬ ((Outcome.limit ℓ : Outcome α) = Outcome.value arb)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.limits_have_structure
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (ℓ : LimitState) : ∃ reason : String, ℓ = LimitState.ArbitraryChoice reason ∨ ℓ = LimitState.LostUniqueness reason ∨ ℓ = LimitState.Contradiction reason ∨ ℓ = LimitState.Undecidable reason ∨ ℓ = LimitState.RegimeBoundary reason

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.map_preserves_limit
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type u} (f : α → β) (ℓ : LimitState) : Outcome.map f (Outcome.limit ℓ : Outcome α) = (Outcome.limit ℓ : Outcome β)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.no_unlabeled_claims
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} : ∀ (x : α), ∃ (c : Claim α), c.statement = x

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.status_weakens
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type u} (c1 : Claim α) (c2 : Claim β) : let combined

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.sdiv_boundary_at_zero
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} [Div α] [BEq α] [OfNat α 0] (n : α) : ∃ ℓ : LimitState, sdiv Regime.Classical α n 0 = Outcome.limit ℓ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.sdiv_preserves_classical
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} [Div α] [BEq α] [OfNat α 0] (n d : α) (h : d ≠ 0) : ∃ v : α, sdiv Regime.Classical α n d = Outcome.value v
